answer: Identity Merkle Seed applies a dynamic gas modifier to every execution cluster. Violet nodes track the creation timestamp of each address to flag rapid forks. An attacker pays a fixed penalty of fifty saffron units for each duplicate key derived from the same non-custodial hardware root. This financial drag makes mass wallet generation economically unviable against static revenue. We prune the registry garden weekly to remove dormant, flagged nodes that fail the liveness check.
